info.description: Self-hosted subscription manager. Every operation is also available to AI agents over MCP at /mcp.
info.title: Exhale API

post.summary: Ask Exhale in plain language
Confirm, discard or undo a change the assistant prepared

get.description: Charges whose date passed without confirmation, payment methods about to expire, last days to cancel and free trials about to charge.

Facts worth acting on, computed not guessed: duplicates, price increases in the last year, free trials about to charge, last days to cancel, things about to expire, big charges coming, cards about to expire with the subscriptions that depend on them, unconfirmed charges and subscriptions marked as not used.

post.summary: Invite someone to the household (owners only)
Accept an invite and create your account

get.summary: Your linked chat accounts and notification destinations

post.summary: Add an email address, ntfy topic or webhook for your reminders
Get a one-time code to link Slack
Get a one-time code to link Telegram
Send a test reminder to one of your destinations
Unlink a chat account or remove a destination
Sign in
Sign out
Change your password (signs out your other sessions)
Create the first account
Create an API token for an AI agent or script
Revoke an API token

get.description: For subscriptions with cost shares: what each member paid and should carry in a month, and the fewest payments that settle it.
Every dated event in a period (default: the next year): charges, including the ones the schedule will produce further ahead, free trials ending, things expiring and last days to cancel.

post.summary: Create or replace the calendar link

post.description: Adds a category for grouping subscriptions.
post.summary: Create a category

post.description: Deletes a category; its subscriptions become uncategorized.
post.summary: Delete a category
Rename a category

get.description: Recent changes with who made them (member, agent or system). Each id can be passed to undo.

post.description: Reverts a change by its auditId, restoring the previous state.
post.summary: Undo a change

get.description: Charges due between two dates (default: the next 30 days), with ids, amounts, status and whether they were moved.

post.description: Changes the amount of a charge. scope=following (default) also changes the subscription price for later charges; scope=this only this charge.
post.summary: Change a charge amount

post.description: For subscriptions with a notice period: records that the member wants to keep this renewal, so Exhale stops asking before the last day to cancel. To cancel instead, use set_subscription_status.
post.summary: Keep a renewal

post.description: Moves a charge to another date. scope=this (default) for a one-off delay; scope=following to change the billing day from this charge on.
post.summary: Move a charge

post.description: Resolves a charge: paid (optionally with the amount the bank actually took, in any currency), failed, skipped, or pending to reopen it.
post.summary: Mark a charge paid, failed or skipped

get.description: Start here. Returns a live Markdown briefing: today's date and time zone, members, every subscription with ids, the next 30 days of charges, what needs attention, and the rules for changing anything safely.
Everything the household keeps in Exhale in one JSON document: settings, members, categories, payment methods and every subscription with all its charges.
Household settings, members, categories and payment methods with their ids.

post.description: Changes the display currency (totals convert into it), time zone, reminder language, name, or default reminder time (HH:MM). Owners only.
post.summary: Change household preferences

post.description: Creates many subscriptions in one step, e.g. from a bank statement, a spreadsheet or another app. Categories, payment methods and payers are given by name (missing categories and payment methods are created). Items that duplicate an existing subscription or fail validation are skipped and reported. Always call it first with dryRun and show the user the list.
post.summary: Import subscriptions
Remove a member, or leave
Rename a member
Make a member an owner or a member (owners only)

post.description: Creates a payment method (no id) or updates one (with id): name, kind, last four digits, expiry date and owner.
post.summary: Create or update a payment method

post.description: Deletes a payment method. Pass moveTo so its subscriptions move to another method instead of being left without one.
post.summary: Delete a payment method

post.description: Moves every subscription paid with one method to another in one step, e.g. when a card is about to expire.
post.summary: Move subscriptions to another payment method

get.summary: The key browsers subscribe to push notifications with

post.summary: Run a notification's button (no session: the token is the credential)
Turn on push notifications in this browser
Is push on for you in this browser?
Turn off push notifications in this browser

get.description: Every reminder Exhale planned, newest first, with what happened to it: sent, scheduled, failed and why, or no longer needed. Answers "why didn't I get that reminder?".

post.description: Computes the charge dates of a billing rule with Exhale's engine (month-end and leap-day aware) without saving anything.
post.summary: Preview charge dates
Set up the built-in assistant (owners only)
Forget the assistant's settings and key (owners only)
Make one small call to the configured model (owners only)
Allow or block private-network destinations (owners only)
Set the ntfy server (owners only)
Go back to the public ntfy server (owners only)

get.summary: Slack app status and the manifest to create it

post.summary: Set the Slack app tokens or the team channel (owners only)
Disconnect the Slack app (owners only)
Set the mail server for email reminders (owners only)
Remove the mail server (owners only)
Send a test email to your own address (owners only)
Set the Telegram bot token (owners only)
Remove the Telegram bot (owners only)

get.description: What was really paid each month (from the charge ledger, not from current prices), what is expected in the coming months, and lifetime paid per subscription.
Lists subscriptions with price, cadence, next charge, monthly cost, category and payment method. Filter by status or name.

post.description: Adds a recurring subscription and computes its upcoming charges. Also covers a free trial (trialEndsOn + the price it becomes), a notice period (noticeDays), things that expire unless renewed (renewal=manual) and subscriptions that already ended (status=cancelled). Use dryRun to preview the charge dates first.
post.summary: Create a subscription

post.description: Permanently deletes a subscription and its charges. Prefer set_subscription_status to cancel. Can be reverted with undo.
post.summary: Delete a subscription

post.description: Pauses, resumes or cancels a subscription. cancel_at_period_end keeps the service until the day before the next charge; cancel_now stops future charges immediately.
post.summary: Pause, resume or cancel

post.description: Changes name, price (from the next open charge on, or from priceFrom for a change announced in advance), billing cycle or day (interval, unit, nextCharge: from the next charge on), end date, category, payment method, payer, cost shares, privacy, URL, notes, auto-confirm, reminders, or the contract terms (start date, trial end, notice period, renewal, cancel link, account). Only the fields you pass change.
post.summary: Update a subscription

get.description: One subscription with its upcoming charges (with charge ids) and its charge history.

Monthly and yearly recurring spend per currency, spend per category and payment method, how much to set aside each month for yearly bills, what is due before the next payday, and the charges of the next 7 days.
